prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw grayscale HEIGHT source atlas for a stylized low-poly game's PBR material art pass.
Primary request: one square full-bleed texture atlas divided exactly into a 4 by 4 grid of equal square material detail panels. No gutters, borders, text, labels, frames, lighting, color, perspective or shadows. Every panel is only a top-down grayscale height field; lighter means slightly raised, darker means recessed. Subtle contrast near mid-gray. The material details must be clean, sparse and understated at gameplay scale, not photorealistic damage. All 16 panels must be present in this exact row-major order:
Row 1: 1 oak wood with restrained long vertical wood grain; 2 end-grain wood with broad rounded growth rings; 3 fine sandstone with a few shallow thin cracks and broad quiet plateaus; 4 tightly woven fabric with subtle woven threads.
Row 2: 5 soft leather fine rounded pores; 6 brushed steel with extremely fine vertical parallel brushing and very sparse scratches; 7 brass with extremely fine quiet vertical polishing marks; 8 smooth painted enamel with tiny subtle orange-peel grain.
Row 3: 9 rubber fine matte stipple; 10 skin nearly featureless smooth soft pores; 11 hair with shallow vertical flowing strands; 12 paper delicate fiber.
Row 4: 13 ceramic almost perfectly flat smooth; 14 glass perfectly flat constant mid-gray; 15 foliage with broad subtle leaf cell texture; 16 electronic display perfectly flat constant mid-gray.
Constraints: strictly monochrome black/white grayscale only. Orthographic top-down technical texture image. No render of a sphere or object. Patterns evenly fill each square panel. No shadows, bevelled panel borders or gradients. These will be converted mathematically into weak normal maps and channel-packed material maps. Make the sheet 1024 by 1024 if possible.
